core_argument: Moving methods that need a transaction boundary into a separate bean, so that every call goes through the proxy, structurally prevents the self-invocation problem.
focus_mechanisms: How Spring AOP creates proxies (CGLIB subclassing and JDK dynamic proxies)
How an internal call through the this reference bypasses the proxy
Thread binding in TransactionInterceptor and TransactionSynchronizationManager
Why the REQUIRES_NEW propagation setting is ignored on self-invocation
